section: Poverty eradication and livelihood programmes - DAY-NRLM, DAY-NULM, SHG movement
subsections: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh, established in 1993, primarily aims at providing which of the following?
o: Micro-credit to poor women in the unorganised sector
accepted.x: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh was established in 1993 to provide micro-credit to poor women working in the unorganised sector.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise objective associated with the named institution.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: Swayamsiddha, launched in 2001, was principally associated with:
o: Integrated empowerment of women through self-help groups
Training of rural youth through RSETIs
accepted.x: Swayamsiddha was an SHG-based programme for the integrated empowerment of women and was launched in 2001.
accepted.tq: Use the year-objective association to distinguish similar women-focused schemes.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Swalamban — Training and employment of poor women
Rashtriya Mahila Kosh — Training rural youth for self-employment
Swayamsiddha — Micro-credit to women in the unorganised sector
STEP — Restructuring of the Twenty Point Programme
accepted.x: Swalamban concerned training and employment of poor women and was the former NORAD scheme. The other pairings assign objectives of different programmes.
accepted.tq: Use objective-based matching and eliminate swapped programme functions.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: The Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women (STEP) is intended to provide:
o: Skills and employment opportunities to women
Only pension support to elderly women
accepted.x: STEP stands for Support to Training and Employment Programme for Women and focuses on skills and employment.
accepted.tq: Expand the official acronym and connect it with its stated function.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the origin and development of the SHG concept:
1. The Grameen Bank model originated in Bangladesh.
2. Professor Muhammad Yunus is associated with the Grameen Bank model.
3. The model emphasised collateral-free loans to poor women.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Grameen Bank model of Bangladesh, associated with Muhammad Yunus, provided collateral-free loans particularly to poor women.
accepted.tq: Combine the place, person and distinguishing feature of a model.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the dates associated with the SHG concept and the Grameen project?
accepted.x: The concept of SHGs is dated to 1975 by CDI, while the Grameen project began in 1976.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between two closely related years rather than treating them as interchangeable.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: In India, self-help groups became a formal instrument for poverty alleviation during the:
accepted.x: SHGs became a formal poverty alleviation tool during the Seventh Five-Year Plan, covering 1985–90.
accepted.tq: Match the institutional development with the correct Plan period.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: MYRADA is associated with which of the following developments?
o: Starting the Community Development Programme in 1952
Pioneering bank linkage of self-help groups in India in the mid-1980s
Launching the Twenty Point Programme in 1975
accepted.x: MYRADA pioneered the bank linkage of SHGs in India in the mid-1980s.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who pioneered what’ approach to distinguish institutions with similar poverty-related roles.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer

accepted.s: Antyodaya was first launched in:
accepted.x: The Antyodaya programme was first launched in Rajasthan in 1977.
accepted.tq: Recall the launch-place and year combination.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the Twenty Point Programme is correct?
accepted.x: The Twenty Point Programme was launched in 1975 and restructured in 1982, 1986 and 2006.
accepted.tq: Separate the original launch year from the successive restructuring years.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. Community Development Programme
B. Launch of the Twenty Point Programme
C. First launch of Antyodaya
D. Establishment of RUDSETI
accepted.x: The Community Development Programme began in 1952, the Twenty Point Programme was launched in 1975, Antyodaya began in 1977, and RUDSETI was established in 1982.
accepted.tq: Use the first and last dates to anchor the sequence, then place the middle events.

accepted.s: RUDSETI stands for:
o: Regional Union for Development and Self Employment Training Institution
Rural Development and Social Education Training Initiative
Rural Development and Self Employment Training Institute
Rural Employment and Development Support Training Institute
accepted.x: RUDSETI stands for Rural Development and Self Employment Training Institute.
accepted.tq: Test exact expansion of an institutional acronym.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about RUDSETI is correct?
o: It was established at Ujire in Karnataka in 1982 and trains rural youth for self-employment.
It was established in Rajasthan in 1977 to provide micro-credit to women.
It was established in Andhra Pradesh in 1992 to refinance banks.
It was established in Delhi in 1975 to restructure the Twenty Point Programme.
accepted.x: RUDSETI was established at Ujire in Karnataka in 1982 and trains rural youth for self-employment. It became a model for the present RSETIs.
accepted.tq: Combine location, year and function while rejecting swapped institutional roles.

accepted.s: The Community Development Programme, described as the ‘mother of social development programmes’, was launched on:
accepted.x: The Community Development Programme was launched on 2 October 1952 and is described as the mother of social development programmes.
accepted.tq: Use the exact commemorative date associated with the programme.

accepted.s: The SHG-Bank Linkage Programme was launched by NABARD as a pilot in:
accepted.x: NABARD launched the SHG-Bank Linkage Programme as a pilot in 1992.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the pilot year from the earlier period of SHG-bank linkage pioneering.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT a role associated with NABARD in the SHG-Bank Linkage Programme?
o: Replacing all commercial banks as direct lenders to SHGs
accepted.x: NABARD refinances banks and trains and promotes SHGs; it does not replace all commercial banks as direct lenders to SHGs.
accepted.tq: Find the institutional role that goes beyond the stated functions of the organisation.

accepted.s: A major lending feature of self-help groups under the SHG-Bank Linkage Programme is that they:
o: Can borrow only from foreign development agencies
Borrow only against immovable property as collateral
Borrow without collateral and generally at lower interest rates
Receive grants that cannot be repaid
accepted.x: SHGs can borrow collateral-free and generally obtain loans at lower interest rates under the linkage programme.
accepted.tq: Apply the defining lending condition to a practical borrowing situation.

accepted.s: Which State is reported as first in the country in SHG-bank linkage under APSES 2024–25?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is reported as first in the country in SHG-bank linkage under APSES 2024–25.
accepted.tq: Use the State-specific performance distinction rather than a generic SHG association.

accepted.s: Which of the following countries are reported to be studying the NRLM SHG model?
o: Botswana, Namibia, Tunisia, Libya and Somalia
Ethiopia, Tanzania, Malawi, Kenya and Rwanda
Nigeria, Ghana, Senegal, Egypt and Morocco
Uganda, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Sudan and Algeria
accepted.x: Ethiopia, Tanzania, Malawi, Kenya and Rwanda are reported to be studying the NRLM SHG model.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete country list without substituting other African countries.

accepted.s: As reported in February 2026, the number of Lakhpati Didis had crossed:
accepted.x: Lakhpati Didis had crossed 2 crore as reported on 3 February 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct scale of a current livelihood indicator.

accepted.s: Multidimensional poverty in India declined from 29.17 per cent in 2013–14 to what level in 2022–23?
accepted.x: The multidimensional poverty ratio declined from 29.17 per cent in 2013–14 to 11.28 per cent in 2022–23.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a precise percentage from nearby altered figures.

accepted.s: The decline in multidimensional poverty from 2013–14 to 2022–23 is associated with approximately how many people?
accepted.x: The decline in multidimensional poverty is associated with approximately 25 crore people.
accepted.tq: Match the percentage trend with its associated absolute number.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a criticism or challenge relating to the SHG movement?
o: Debt stress caused by poor financial literacy
accepted.x: Uneven SHG quality, weak market links, debt stress due to poor financial literacy and political interference are identified challenges. The material does not identify an absence of political interference as a criticism.
accepted.tq: Select the option that reverses a stated challenge.

accepted.s: A self-help group has poor financial literacy and faces repayment pressure from multiple borrowings. This situation most directly illustrates:
o: The formalisation of SHGs during the Seventh Plan
Debt stress associated with the SHG movement
The collateral-free nature of SHG lending
accepted.x: Debt stress arising from poor financial literacy is one of the criticisms and challenges associated with the SHG movement.
accepted.tq: Apply a stated criticism to a short practical case.

accepted.s: Which of the following best explains the significance of the Andhra Pradesh model in the national livelihood mission context?
o: The SERP/Velugu model of Andhra Pradesh became a template for NRLM.
The model restricted SHGs to urban areas only.
The model replaced NABARD as the national refinancing agency.
The model was created exclusively for training government employees.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh’s SERP/Velugu model became a template for the National Rural Livelihoods Mission.
accepted.tq: Identify the State model that influenced a national programme.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh and self-help groups:
1. Andhra Pradesh’s SERP/Velugu model became a template for NRLM.
2. Andhra Pradesh leads the country in SHG-bank linkage.
3. Andhra Pradesh was the place where the Grameen Bank was founded.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because the Grameen Bank model originated in Bangladesh, not Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Separate Andhra Pradesh-specific achievements from the foreign origin of the Grameen model.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with its broad focus?
o: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh — Micro-credit to poor women in the unorganised sector
Swayamsiddha — Rural youth self-employment training at Ujire
RUDSETI — Integrated empowerment of women through SHGs
Community Development Programme — SHG-bank linkage pilot of 1992
accepted.x: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh focused on micro-credit to poor women in the unorganised sector. The other options interchange the functions of Swayamsiddha, RUDSETI and NABARD’s 1992 pilot.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure objective-function pair and reject cross-linked distractors.
accepted.sec: Women-focused livelihood schemes and SHG pioneer
